description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the wanted poster workflow: turn an owned character portrait into a wanted poster lettered with posterName and bounty (bounty is 500 GOLD when empty). Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_wanted_poster with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_wanted_poster.

values.description: Workflow inputs. Quote and run with identical values.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery
